rows.grounds: object of invocation; personified as goddess
main verb expressing the act of calling upon
optative request directed to the goddess

items.question: Whom does the speaker invoke and what favor is requested from the goddess Śrī?
premises: The speaker invokes the goddess Śrī.
Śrī is explicitly addressed as a goddess.
The speaker requests that the goddess Śrī favor him.
items.inference: The verse constitutes a prayer in which the speaker invokes goddess Śrī and asks for her favor.
uncertainties: The term śriyam/śrīḥ can denote both prosperity and the goddess personified; the presence of devīm/devī supports personification.
items.plain_english: I invoke the goddess Śrī; may the goddess Śrī be pleased with me.
